context_for_next_testing_agent: Fleet Reports and Block/Unblock features fully tested and working: 1) GET /api/tenant/fleet-reports returns summary (total_vehicles, total_bookings, pending_bookings, blocked_cars), most_booked_cars ranked list, daily_availability with donut chart data, location_summary with utilization %. 2) GET /api/tenant/fleet-reports/csv exports CSV file. 3) POST /api/vehicles/{id}/block blocks vehicle with reason (Service/Cleaning/Other) and optional notes. 4) POST /api/vehicles/{id}/unblock returns vehicle to fleet. 5) Service alert in scan-update response when mileage approaches service_due_mileage. 6) Vehicle cards display mileage, service_due, tax, nct, location with service alert banner. 7) Edit Vehicle modal has all fields.
